versions.changelog:
- Updated all user-facing text and instructions from Chinese to English for broader accessibility.
- No functional or structural changes; only language localization.
- All interactive questions, headers, and sample dialogues now use clear and concise English prompts.
- Documentation and usage flow remain the same; all sample `question` tool JSON revised to English labels and prompts.

- Updated the documentation title from "Workstation Skill" to "Jenkins Skill" for clarity.
- No feature logic, interface, or code changes; documentation wording has been refreshed and streamlined.
- Content and step-by-step instructions remain the same.

Initial release of Jenkins CI/CD integration skill.

- Trigger Jenkins builds via REST API with a guided, step-by-step interactive process.
- Manage project configurations (add/update projects) using an interactive question tool.
- Automatically detects current project context and assists with configuration if missing.
- All user input and selection handled through interactive question prompts—no manual typing of commands needed.
- Builds are triggered and results are displayed with clear, concise feedback.
- Includes FAQ and guidance for handling connection, authentication, and project errors.
